benchmark: Godot ARC/Bolt ECS Pop-n-Shoot Entity Benchmark
conclusion: The historical claim of '30% memory leaked 1m memref' is NOT REPRODUCED in the ARC/Bolt ECS engine. Under rigorous 10,000-frame simulation with 8-12 concurrent entities per frame, all 60,004 allocated entities and their components were 100% cleanly freed via explicit component dereferencing and round cleanup (0% leak).
